rfam.comment: U6atac is an essential component of the minor U12-type spliceosome complex which is required for removal of the rarer class of eukaryotic introns (AT-AC, U12-type) [1]. U6atac snRNA is proposed to form a base-paired complex with another spliceosomal RNA U4atac via two stem loop regions. These interacting stem loops have been shown to be required for in vivo splicing [2]. U6atac is the functional analog of U6 (Rfam:RF00026) in the major U2-type spliceosomal complex [2].
